HediffDef.label: flesh adaptation
HediffDef.description: A tumor-like module produced by the flesh hive. It affects the implant user's mind and spirit, removing disgust toward flesh creatures, flesh-made products, and even twisted meat, allowing them to live better alongside the flesh hive.

HediffDef.label: flesh symbiosis
HediffDef.description: A flesh symbiosis module links its host to the flesh hive, allowing the host to draw nutrition directly from the hive when severely hungry.
